title: "Pay Start cutover packet"
description: "Source and operator checklist for a future Pay Worker cutover."
updatedAt: "2026-11-09"

---

Pay has a TanStack Start/Void candidate. Production publication and routing are
held; this packet records the source target and checks required before Rex
authorizes a cutover. It does not authorize deployment, payment activity,
provider changes or data writes.

## Worker and configuration

- Worker: `tuturuuu-pay` for production; the staging Worker name for the
  isolated staging candidate.
- Hosts: `pay.tuturuuu.com` and the `/pay` mount on `tuturuuu.com`. Staging
  must use the separately approved staging host and zone.
- Build: `cd apps/pay && bun run build:cloudflare`.
- Static asset binding: `ASSETS`. Optional internal API origin variable:
  `INTERNAL_WEB_API_ORIGIN`.
- Staging profile variable names: `TUTURUUU_NOINDEX`,
  `INTERNAL_WEB_API_ORIGIN`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_WEB_APP_URL`,
  `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL`, `PAY_APP_URL`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`, and
  `POLAR_SANDBOX`. Supply sandbox-only provider values through the approved
  environment; never put credentials in this page or profile.
- Runtime secret names: `CRON_SECRET`, `POLAR_ACCESS_TOKEN`,
  `POLAR_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, `SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY`, and
  `TUTURUUU_APP_COORDINATION_SECRET`. Configure them only through the protected
  runtime secret store. This packet contains names, never values.

## Smoke checks

After an authorized cutover, run the public build identity probes against both
hosts and verify the native runtime header and expected source SHA:

```sh
curl -fsS -D - https://pay.tuturuuu.com/api/build-info
curl -fsSI https://tuturuuu.com/pay/api/build-info
```

The release operator must also run the signed-in billing and sandbox checkout
smokes in [Pay staging acceptance](./pay-start), including webhook signature
rejection, then watch authentication and 5xx behavior. Do not invoke billing,
webhook, cron or migration endpoints as a smoke substitute.

## Rollback

Before routing changes, Rex records the immutable Vercel deployment ID and the
exact routes, custom domains and DNS records being replaced, plus the one-step
restore command and rollback owner. No deployment ID is recorded in this
repository, so Rex must capture it. Restore that routing to the prior deployment
immediately if smoke or the post-cutover watch regresses. Keep the deployment
available for the full release cycle.
